prompt_policy: H3 uses native single-pass BasicGuider. The negative_prompt is retained as a review contract and its constraints are folded into effective_prompt because this H3 node does not expose a supported independent negative-conditioning input.

rule05_yes.positive_prompt: Locked tripod technical training shot with a fixed composition matching the reference image. One gloved operator performs one slow, precise placement of the copper busbar into the fixture by its edges. Keep the central slot, contact point, holes, glove color, copper shape, workbench, and watercolor ink linework unchanged. The placement happens once in the middle of the shot, followed by a steady hold on the seated final position.
rule05_yes.negative_prompt: flicker, strobing, frame-to-frame color shift, unstable exposure, full-frame smear, severe blur, object morphing, changing glove identity, bare skin human hand, extra hands, extra fingers, duplicated tools, uncontrolled camera shake, random zoom, random pan, scene cut, double exposure, text, subtitles, watermark

rule05_no.positive_prompt: Technical training failure demonstration in the same locked composition and watercolor ink workbench style. The operator performs one readable copper busbar placement while the tripod framing makes one gentle, controlled left-right wobble; the operation remains recognizable and the motion settles before the final hold.
rule05_no.negative_prompt: flicker, strobing, frame-to-frame color shift, unstable exposure, violent jitter, random zoom, random reframing, full-frame smear, severe blur, object morphing, changing glove identity, bare skin human hand, extra hands, extra fingers, duplicated tools, scene cut, double exposure, text, subtitles, watermark
